meta.description: Unofficial English glosses for pty.snroFlg block labels and meanings
meta.source_note: Japanese meanings are the FFVD Games flag note (2021-06-11), kept verbatim. These English glosses are a community translation, not official localization text.
meta.block_note: blocks maps each verbatim Japanese block label to an English display name. 167 labels cover 169 bytes because two labels (DoomsdayMachine, party info save area) each appear on two bytes. Scrap appears under two Japanese labels; the source numbering is kept and 0x054 is marked as the town block.
meta.conventions: Chapter, place and character names follow the game's own English asset names where they exist (Scrap, Koorong, Chateau Aiguille, Shingrow, Cygnus, Tanzer). Item names follow docs/constants.json where the Japanese term maps cleanly (Cure, PowerCure, MaxCure, SanctuaryStone); otherwise the gloss is descriptive and the glossary says so. Dialogue is translated literally, keeping the quote.
meta.untranslated_rule: A meaning or block label absent here is rendered in Japanese only by the viewer. Coverage is gated at build time: all 710 unique meanings and all 167 unique block labels must be present.
